remarks: Step into a piece of history with this delightful 803 sq. ft. one-bedroom apartment at Woodside Green, nestled in a beautifully maintained building dating back to 1939. Overflowing with character and brimming with natural light, this corner unit combines vintage charm with modern convenience. The generously sized bedroom provides a tranquil retreat, offering ample closet space and a cozy atmosphere. The well-designed kitchen, though compact, is perfectly functional, and the classic bathroom features vintage tiles and fixtures that contribute to the home's nostalgic charm.   Situated in a desirable mid-city location, this apartment provides easy access to Ridgeway Shopping Center and public transportation, making it an ideal spot for those seeking a mix of historic appeal and urban convenience. Don't miss this true gem.
